posts.title: What is BSD? Come to a conference to find out!
posts.description: © 2025, 2026 Peter N. M. Hansteen What is BSD? It's where the Internet comes from! Berkeley Software Distribution (BSD) is a family of computer operating systems derived from the software developed at the University of California at Berkeley from the late 1970s through the early 1990s. posts.title: A Major Mail Provider Demonstrate They Likely Do Not Understand Mail At All
posts.description: © 2026 Peter N. M. Hansteen So it happened again. A major mail provider proved that they do not, in fact, understand how modern email works. I've been running mail services for longer than I care to remember.
